name: Blue Moon Cottages
signature: Three 1940s cottages 250 metres from Rye bay beach — Sandpiper is the dog-friendly unit with a wood fire and fenced courtyard
editorNote:
Three 1940s cottages sitting 250 metres from Rye's bay beach. The dog-welcoming unit is Sandpiper — one bedroom plus loft, wood fire, fenced courtyard, no extra pet fee listed. The winter fireplace experience is the reason most guests return: load up at the Red Hill Community Market on Saturday morning, light the fire by afternoon.

Blue Moon draws one of the highest proportions of repeat visitors in the Peninsula cottage category. The bay beach is close enough to walk in five minutes; the hinterland wine country is twenty minutes away. No nightly rates published on the website — contact directly for current pricing.
whyWeGo: 250 metres from Rye bay beach, dog-friendly, 1940s character — the clearest fireplace-and-beach cottage combination on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book Sandpiper if dogs are coming — fenced courtyard, no extra pet fee.
dogFriendlyNotes: Sandpiper unit confirmed dog-friendly. No extra pet fee listed. Small dogs preferred. Confirm dog policy when booking.
